r_b.mechanical_distinctness: NON-LOCATION, NON-TP transform. Z_WW standardizes run count R of a median-dichotomized sequence (mu_R=1+2*n1*n2/(n1+n2), WW variance) measuring randomness/clustering of above/below-median runs. Distinct from exhausted location family (C86 Hodges–Lehmann Walsh-average-median, C85 Gastwirth tercile L-estimator, C84 Midhinge, C83 Tukey trimean) — run-count on dichotomy, not level/center. Distinct from C87 Turning-Point Rate TP=(1/(n-2))*sum I[(dx_{i-1})*(dx_i)<0] (local peak/trough reversals of consecutive raw differences/triplet oscillation) — different operation (median dichotomy + contiguous same-side run-length grouping) and different randomness null/normalization. Distinct from ACF/autocorr (linear lag-1 covariance of continuous series vs binary dichotomized-sequence run clustering), C41-C43 entropy (distributional symbol-probability information/complexity vs single standardized run-count), C80 MAD/C82 AAD (scale/dispersion), C66-C73 quantile dispersions/asymmetries, moment/Bowley/Kelly skewness & kurtosis, C79 Sarle BC/C45 CV/C51,C74-C78 inequality, and other C23/C40-C87 RQV transforms. Data identical (real_quote_volume); transform mechanically different.
